Title: ELSA-2026-500394: Unbreakable Enterprise kernel security update (IMPORTANT)
Description:
[6.12.0-207.111.5.3]
- mm/pagewalk: fix stale walk->action escaping walk_pmd_range() (Hyunwoo Kim)  [Orabug: 40157478]  {CVE-2026-89754}
- exec: Cleanup POSIX timers right after de_thread() (Hyunwoo Kim)  [Orabug: 40157474]  {CVE-2026-98260}

[6.12.0-207.111.5.2]
- PCI: Fix BAR resize for devices on a root bus (Liz Fong-Jones)
- PCI: Fix Resizable BAR restore order (Ilpo Jarvinen)
- dpll: use exact lookup for reference sync pin id (Ivan Vecera)
- Bluetooth: RFCOMM: Reject short EA=0 frames in rfcomm_recv_frame() (Hui Peng)
- ocfs2: make ocfs2_calc_xattr_init() return void (Joseph Qi)
- selinux: recheck intermediate backing files on mprotect() (Karl Mehltretter)
- selinux: preserve user SID across nested backing files (Karl Mehltretter)
- ASoC: ux500: Parenthesize MSP_{RX,TX}_CLKPOL_BIT() arguments (Sasha Levin)
- Bluetooth: hci_core: Fix queuing tx_work after workqueue is drained (ThangNN99)
- Bluetooth: hci_core: Print number of packets in conn->data_q (Luiz Augusto von Dentz)
- drm/msm/dsi: round the byte clock rate after reparenting to the PHY PLL (Dmitry Baryshkov)
- ALSA: bcd2000: Fix race between rawmidi and disconnect (Takashi Iwai)
- Revert 'hwmon: (emc1403) Rely on subsystem locking' (Sasha Levin)
- Revert 'hwmon: (emc1403) Drop hysteresis for low limit temperature' (Sasha Levin)
- landlock: Fix use-after-free of the source's parent directory (Norbert Szetei)  [Orabug: 40132006]  {CVE-2026-97594}
- landlock: Clarify documentation for the IOCTL access right (Gunther Noack)  [Orabug: 40132006]
- xfrm: Fix dev use-after-free in xfrm async resumption (Dong Chenchen)  [Orabug: 40131990]  {CVE-2026-72463}
- xfrm: Refactor xfrm_input lock to reduce contention with RSS (Jianbo Liu)  [Orabug: 40131990]
- pidfd: hold exec_update_lock around namespace ioctl (Chen Linxuan)  [Orabug: 40131986]  {CVE-2026-89766}
- ipv6: mcast: use copy-on-write RCU updates in ip6_mc_source() (Eric Dumazet)  [Orabug: 40131835]  {CVE-2026-98101}
- ipv6: mcast: Don't hold RTNL for MCAST_ socket options. (Kuniyuki Iwashima)  [Orabug: 40131835]
- ipv6: mcast: Don't hold RTNL for IPV6_DROP_MEMBERSHIP and MCAST_LEAVE_GROUP. (Kuniyuki Iwashima)  [Orabug: 40131835]
- ipv6: mcast: Don't hold RTNL for IPV6_ADD_MEMBERSHIP and MCAST_JOIN_GROUP. (Kuniyuki Iwashima)  [Orabug: 40131835]
- ipv6: mcast: Use in6_dev_get() in ipv6_dev_mc_dec(). (Kuniyuki Iwashima)  [Orabug: 40131835]
- net: cpsw: Execute ndo_set_rx_mode callback in a work queue (Kevin Hao)  [Orabug: 40131835]
- net: cpsw_new: Execute ndo_set_rx_mode callback in a work queue (Kevin Hao)  [Orabug: 40131835]
